steps.dump: (() => { const out = {}; for (const t of ['Continue with Apple', 'Continue with Google', 'Continue as Guest']) { const el = [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.textContent.trim() === t); out[t] = el ? { top: Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top), primary: el.className.includes('bl-primary') } : null; } out.guestCopy = document.body.innerText.includes('every screen is open to guests'); return JSON.stringify(out); })()
